author: The Thought Emporium
description:
Welcome back to our podcast "We can have nice things, actually!". This second episode we are joined by Tom from @ExplosionsAndFire and discuss the antibiotic apocalypse and ways we can prevent that aren't just "invent more antibiotics". From phages, to UV lights, and a little history.

Find us on spotify: https://open.spotify.com/episode/72YffQBwuLX7Gf02a7ajrA?si=6Hz1N6mUSx2plsOQTzu0uQ
